method.frame_convention: Zero-based decoded frames of the named retained file; FFmpeg showinfo PTS in seconds. Nominal YouTube fps is not used to compute timestamps.
method.media_processing: First two HLS downloads remuxed without re-encoding to indexed MP4; third downloaded chapter 219-476s. Sequential decoding, select by frame index, no seek for measurement.
method.response: Entry: blue slow effect and action locks. Supports: HUD response with character switch. Screen reactions are not physical input timestamps.
method.bracket: Last sampled pre-response / first sampled response; 5 frames at 59.94fps or 3 frames at 30fps. Sampling uncertainty only, not success width or confidence interval.
method.anchor: One manually chosen readable prompt frame per source, with fade-in ambiguity. No cross-device detector or latency calibration.

tools.FFmpeg: Bundled imageio-ffmpeg binary; sequential showinfo and raw RGB extraction
